title: Will "quantum" be added to the dictionary with coffee-related definition?
body:
Resolves YES if any major English dictionary (Merriam-Webster, Oxford, Cambridge) adds a new definition of "quantum" specifically related to coffee brewing by end of 2025.

This would legitimize quantum coffee as a recognized phenomenon rather than just a marketing term.
summary: Whether any major English dictionary will add a coffee-related definition of "quantum" by end of 2025.

comments.content: Dictionaries don't work this fast. Maybe in 2030. NO is the play.
